name: Niger
description: Niger from the Sahara's dinosaurs and Agadez to the Songhai and Hausa states, French rule, independence in 1960, uranium and coups.

checkpoints.name: Sahara and Sahel
checkpoints.note: Tuareg sultans ruled Agadez, the Songhai held the river, and Hausa states the south.

checkpoints.name: French Niger
checkpoints.note: France conquered the land and made it a colony in 1922.

checkpoints.name: Independent Niger
checkpoints.note: Niger became independent in 1960. Uranium was mined from the 1970s, and coups came in 1974, 1996, 1999, 2010 and 2023.
